titleTemplate.title: Page title pattern
titleTemplate.description: How product and category page titles are written: {name} is the product or category, {business} your business name.

gradedCondition.title: Condition of graded items
gradedCondition.description: The condition search engines are told for graded items whose grade names no condition. Items without a grade are new.

sitemapUrl.title: Sitemap address
sitemapUrl.description: Where your website serves the sitemap. With more than 50,000 pages it is split into pages at this address with ?page=1, ?page=2 …

sitemapSize.title: Addresses per sitemap file
sitemapSize.description: Above this many addresses the sitemap becomes an index of files (categories, landing pages, products-1, products-2 …).

defaultDescription.title: Default description
defaultDescription.description: Used when a page has no description of its own.

defaultImage.title: Default image
defaultImage.description: An https address used when a page has no image of its own.

indexNowOnSave.title: Send changes to IndexNow
indexNowOnSave.description: When a product or category is saved, its address is sent to search engines through Growth's IndexNow (paste the Growth token in Connections).
